root_cause.summary: A failed MCP initialize/request handshake could leave a child process assigned to the extension-host singleton with initialized=false and child still non-null. A later dashboard snapshot or restored tab reused that stale identity path without child-scoped pending cleanup, so the webview stayed in Connecting/Not synced until manual lifecycle disruption.
root_cause.repair: Pending JSON-RPC requests are now associated with the exact child that owns them; child exit, stop, timeout, and reconnect replace or drain only that child's requests. Snapshot refresh performs one bounded reconnect and posts Live only after a real aiworkhub_dashboard_snapshot payload arrives.

regression.scenario: Two initialized repositories are opened through two independent simulated VS Code extension-host module instances. Repo A's child handshakes normally. Repo B's first child dies before initialize and its restored/refresh snapshot must reconnect without tab close/reopen.
isolation_assertions: distinct AIWORKHUB_REPO_ROOT and AIWORKHUB_REPO_ID child environments
repo-local coordinator token files under each repository root
repo A snapshot contains no repo B identity
repo B snapshot contains no repo A identity
